Sofia Chen: Hey finance — charge on corpcard "SFO PARK" $42.50 on 2026-03-18. Policy needs itemized receipt for >$25, but my only proof is the bank screenshot. Any workaround?
Samir Patel: Do you have the card last4 and txn id? Parking vendors sometimes give only a code; we can match on txn id.
Sofia Chen: Last4 3456. I just grabbed this from the online statement, no itemized PDF.
FinanceBot: Reminder: acceptable docs: vendor receipt, parking stub photo, or manager approval + bank screenshot for airport parking. Missing docs may delay reimbursement.
Priya Rao: @Sofia if this was travel, upload a quick photo of the parking machine ticket (entry/exit time) or confirm flight details + manager sign-off. That usually suffices.
Sofia Chen: Uploaded image here: https://files.redwood.com/receipts/parking_20260318_3456.jpg — shows timestamps but the merchant field is blank.
Jules Martin: Confirming I approved this expense — customer onsite visit on 3/18. Approved. :thumbsup: I can add a note in Concur.
Samir Patel: Please paste the bank transaction id (you can get it from Corpcard portal > transaction details). Finance uses that to reconcile with the processor.
Sofia Chen: Transaction ID: TXN-0b9f8a (added to expense note).
Marta Lopez: Thanks. I'll mark category `travel:parking` and set approver Jules Martin. We'll process this in the next reimbursement batch.
Priya Rao: Processing checklist:
- bank screenshot attached
- photo of ticket attached
- manager approval on thread
- txn id included
All items present, forwarding to payments.
Samir Patel: Note for team: corpcard posts sometimes use abbreviated merchant names; if merchant mismatch occurs we contact the card processor for clarification.
Sofia Chen: Great — appreciate the help. I'll check the portal for the expense status later.
FinanceBot: Expense submitted to Finance queue (ID 2026-EXP-784). Estimated reimbursement: next payroll cycle.
